name: Prophet

VINIT.chosen_element: The Silence of the Unspoken Word
VINIT.justification: The state of potentiality before the divine address enters the human consciousness.

TANCH.justification: The final closure of the prophetic cycle where the word and reality become indistinguishable.

AFWD.justification: The upward movement of the human spirit to receive the transcendent message.

AREV.justification: The return of the prophet to the social sphere to deliver the received word.

CLINK.justification: The sequential transmission of authority from one prophetic office to the next.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the individual as a chosen vessel for the divine voice.

FSPLIT.justification: The single message branches into the Blessing for the obedient and the Curse for the rebellious.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the faithful community from those who survived both the blessing and the curse.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative response to the prophetic warning leading to restoration.

EVALF.justification: The negative response to the prophetic warning leading to judgment.

ENGAGR.justification: The prophet holds the divine wrath and the human guilt simultaneously without resolving the tension.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the oral prophecy into an unchangeable scriptural record.

phase_3.void_description: The pre-revelatory void where no divine command has been articulated.
phase_3.true_description: The state of alignment with the divine will through obedience.
phase_3.false_description: The state of deviation from the divine will through rebellion.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the intercessor who stands in the breach between judgment and mercy.

steps.domain_action: The silence before the call of the prophet.
The prophet recognizes their own identity as a chosen messenger.
The prophet ascends to the divine presence to receive the decree.
The decree is permanently etched into the prophet's consciousness.
The prophet descends back to the human community.
The prophet delivers the word which splits the audience into two paths.
One group hears the word and moves toward repentance.
Another group hears the word and hardens their heart in rebellion.
The prophet stands between both groups to intercede for the whole.
The faithful remnant is gathered from the results of the proclamation.
The prophet appoints a successor to carry the word forward.
The entire cycle is recorded in a scroll for future generations.
The prophetic mission is sealed until the end of the age.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit translating divine intent into human language.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The collective memory of the covenantal community.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Kairos or the appointed time of divine intervention.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Torah or the foundational law that validates the prophecy.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The physical and social life of the prophet.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A community in a state of spiritual drift.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A community redefined by its response to the word.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy of the divine word is conserved as it moves from potentiality to historical record.
